en.查看节点状态、分支路径与执行产物。需要调整时，回到画布继续修改和测试。: Inspect step status, branches and artifacts. Return to the canvas to make changes and test again.
en.创建一次执行，保留流程快照: Start a run and save its flow snapshot
en.逐步记录节点输入与输出: Record each step's input and output
en.结果与产物关联到运行记录: Link results and artifacts to the run
en.支持取消、重试与历史回溯: Cancel, retry and review past runs
en.画出步骤，定义方向。: Draw the steps. Set the direction.
en.用触发、AI 节点与条件分支，把团队的经验组织成清晰、可编辑、可执行的流程。: Use triggers, AI steps and conditions to turn team experience into clear, editable, executable workflows.
en.导入团队文档，检索相关原文。让每次回答带着上下文，也留下可以核对的来源。: Import team documents and find relevant passages. Give every answer context and a source you can verify.
en.过程透明，掌控在手。: A clear process. In your control.
en.查看执行的每一步，管理成员与访问权限。让工作有结果，也让过程有迹可循。: Inspect every execution step and manage team access. Get results and keep a clear record of the process.
en.在画布里，画出下一步。: Draw the next step on the canvas.
en.从触发到分支，把复杂工作拆成清晰步骤。自动保存，随时测试。: Break complex work into clear steps, from triggers to branches. Autosave and test as you go.
en.支持 PDF、Word、Excel 与文本。让代理从你的团队资料中寻找答案。: Use PDF, Word, Excel and text. Let agents find answers in your team's material.
en.在记录里，看见全过程。: See the whole story in your runs.
en.查看节点输入、输出与分支状态。执行可取消，失败可重试。: Inspect inputs, outputs and branch status. Cancel a run or retry after failure.
en.Owner、Admin、Member 与 Viewer 角色，配合可撤销的访问密: Owner, Admin, Member and Viewer roles, with revocable API keys, make access boundaries clear.
en.了解账号、模型、部署与备份恢复。: Learn about accounts, models, deployment and backup restoration.
en.下载原创 Logo、字标和品牌使用说明。: Download the original logo, wordmark and brand guidelines.
en.进入 Settings → Members，点击 Invite member。: Open Settings → Members, then choose Invite member.
en.填写同事邮箱并选择角色，然后发送邀请。: Enter their email, choose a role, then share the invitation.
en.对方接受邀请后，即可加入你的工作空间。: They can join your workspace after accepting the invitation.
en.查阅知识库，起草回复: Search knowledge and draft a reply
en.保留草稿，等待人工确认: Save a draft for human review
en.客服请求从输入到回复草稿: A support request from input to reply draft
en.查看节点输入、输出和分支执行路径: Inspect step inputs, outputs and branch paths
en.三步，跑通你的第一个工作流: Your first flow, in three steps
en.跟着实际操作，创建一个小工作流，传入数据，看看每一步发生了什么。: Learn by doing. Build a small workflow, send it some data and see exactly what happens.
en.你拥有查看权限，可以浏览工作流、检查运行记录，也可以设置自己的资料。: You have view access. Explore workflows, inspect run traces and personalize your profile.
en.从两个相连的节点开始，无需 API 密钥或外部账号。: Start with two connected steps. No API key or external account is needed.
en.点击右上角「运行」。你也可以在「测试输入」中修改 JSON，观察各个节点执行完成: Click Run in the top right. Open Test input to try your own JSON, then watch each step finish.
en.打开运行详情，对照每个节点的输入、输出和执行记录。: Open the run details to compare input, output and the trace for every step.
en.看看画布上的节点如何连接。: Browse the canvas and its connected steps.
en.查看以往运行的输入、输出与错误。: Read past inputs, outputs and errors.
en.修改姓名、界面外观和语言。: Update your name, appearance and language.
en.引导进度会随账号保存，随时都能重新打开。: Your progress is saved to your account. You can reopen this guide at any time.
en.接下来可以添加 AI 节点、接入知识库，或从空白画布开始搭建。: Next, add AI steps, connect your knowledge or build a flow from scratch.
en.请先成功运行引导工作流，再查看运行结果。: Complete a successful tutorial run before reviewing its result.
en.请先登录账号，再使用新人引导。: Use an account session for onboarding.

en.设置这台设备上的界面外观。: Choose how Flowloom looks on this device.
en.在通知中包含失败的工作流运行。: Include failed workflow runs in notifications.
en.包含工作空间活动的每周摘要。: Include a weekly summary of workspace activity.
en.配置邮件服务后接收更新。: Receive updates when an email service is configured.
en.设置代理形象和欢迎方式。: How the agent looks and greets people.
en.为代理提供能力的模型。: The model that powers this agent.
en.告诉代理它的职责和回复方式。: Tell the agent what it should do and how to respond.
en.代理可用于执行操作的应用。: Apps the agent can use to get things done.
en.代理查找答案时可用的知识来源。: Sources the agent can search for answers.
en.设置代理的行为边界。: Set boundaries for how your agent works.
en.让回复围绕你的指令。: Keep responses focused on your instructions.
en.修改外部数据前先确认。: Confirm actions that change external data.
en.保护个人信息与私密数据。: Keep personal and private information safe.
en.让团队协作融入工作流: Bring your team into the flow
en.当 Gmail 收到新邮件时启动。: Starts when a new email lands in Gmail.
en.在计划时间启动工作流。: Starts the flow at a scheduled time.
en.收到 Webhook 请求时启动。: Starts when a webhook is received.
en.把输入内容归入你指定的标签。: Sorts input into the labels you choose.
en.参考帮助中心起草回复。: Drafts a reply grounded in the help center.
en.向频道或个人发送消息。: Posts to a channel or a person.
en.创建带有标签和优先级的工单。: Files an issue with labels and priority.
en.发送或起草 Gmail 邮件。: Sends or drafts a Gmail message.
en.根据条件把工作流分为不同分支。: Splits the flow on a condition.
en.等待一段时间后执行下一步。: Waits before running the next step.
en.返回工作流的结果。: Returns the result of your workflow.

en.从发票附件中提取总额与到期日。: Pulls totals and due dates from invoice attachments.
en.每周一早晨汇总产品指标。: Summarizes product metrics every Monday morning.
en.参考帮助中心解答客户问题，并提交缺陷工单。: Answers customers from the help center and files bugs.
en.检查合并请求的正确性和安全性。: Reviews pull requests for correctness and security.
en.回答产品问题，并附上文档链接。: Answers product questions with links to the docs.
en.研究新客户并起草沟通内容。: Researches new accounts and drafts outreach.
en.汇集公开帮助文章、快捷回复与已知问题。: Every public help article, macro, and known issue.
en.开发文档、API 参考和操作指南。: Developer docs, API reference, and guides.
